$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.2.0-draft (pre-1.0). Mirrors backend/services/api/schemas.py InvestigationCreateRequest and the UrlSource | UploadSource union discriminated on kind, field for field.
title: InvestigationCreateRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/investigations (BE-05, #19). Requires the Idempotency-Key header: the same key with the same body replays the original 202, the same key with a different body is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Exactly one source: a complete accessible video by URL, or a completed upload. A declared duration above OVRLY_MAX_SHARED_DURATION_SECONDS is 422 DURATION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

source.description: Discriminated union on kind. Branches differ structurally (url versus upload_id), so the shape stays unambiguous even where enum checks are relaxed.

duration_ms.description: Client-declared media duration in milliseconds, positive when present. Optional and nullable, as in the Pydantic model; the server checks it against the shared-media limit.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL of the complete video (Pydantic AnyHttpUrl). The server does not download it at intake.

upload_id.description: An upload owned by the caller in state completed; otherwise 409 UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE or 404.
